limitations: A private live copy and chunk receipt times are flushed during capture; public evidence is written on controlled shutdown.
OPEN acknowledgement describes monitor/port and TCP connection, not an ESP32 command response.
STATUS queries only in the predefined middle phase at no faster than approximately 200ms; extra serial output perturbs scheduling. No explicit DTR/RTS transitions.
Line timestamps are host receipt of complete line, not HX conversion times.
STATUS lines are cached snapshots, not every HX conversion.
Boot text may have occurred before opening and cannot be recovered.
